messages:
alex: CI green yesterday, woke up to a red on main after the toolchain image roll. cc @maria @chris, can someone triage?
ci-bot: Build #4521 failed on group linux/x86_64 with exit code 2. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/4521
maria: which target is failing? single test or a bunch?
alex: lots of compile/link errors starting from //third_party/rocksdb:rocksdb_proxy and cascading. first visible error snippet: ```/workspace/third_party/rocksdb/table/block_builder.cc:45:10: fatal error: 'atomic' file not found``` also later: ```undefined reference to `__cxa_throw_bad_alloc'```
chris: sounds like headers/toolchain mismatch (libstdc++ vs libc++ headers) or the image switched C++ standard library. did the image bump change GCC/libstdc++ version?
alex: AFAIK the image tag moved from gcc11-2025-11 to gcc12-2026-03. Buildkite env shows CC=gcc CXX=g++ in the new image.
jen: can someone try a local reproduce with the new image or at least run `bazel build //third_party/rocksdb:rocksdb_proxy` locally? If it's flaky we can rerun CI.
tim: I'll kick a rerun on the failed agent for quick verification. if it fails again, we should start a bisect on the image roll commit range.
chris: I'll start a bisect across the toolchain image commits. quick steps for anyone following: ```git checkout main && git bisect start HEAD v2026-02-28 && git bisect run bazel build //third_party/rocksdb:rocksdb_proxy``` note: use a hermetic build (no cached system libs).
maria: also try `bazel clean --expunge` before build, some CI images had stale sysroot mounts causing header not found.
alex: repro locally after `--expunge` shows the same missing header. attaching short log: ```#include <atomic> // error: file not found```
chris: opening a bisect job now, will ping here when I have the culprit image tag. ETA ~30-45m.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by @tim for build #4521.
jen: if bisect points to the image, we should either pin back to the previous image or add a small compatibility shim in the build config. prefer pin for immediate recovery.
maria: agreed. ops: can we revert image in the build pool if bisect confirms? @tim can you coordinate?
tim: will stand by to rollback if chris confirms.
alex: thanks all — I'll prepare a minimal repro and a bisection note to paste into the bisect PR. please @me when you have the bad image tag. :handshake:
